task_completion.description: The agent successfully loads the chest CT scan into the 3D Slicer interface.
task_completion.visual_evidence: 3D Slicer application is open showing a chest CT scan in the axial, sagittal, and coronal viewers.

task_completion.description: The agent navigates to the subcarinal region (Station 7), located just below the tracheal bifurcation (carina).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The axial slice viewer shows the anatomy immediately inferior to the division of the main bronchi.

task_completion.description: The agent uses the ruler or markup tool to measure the short-axis diameter of a lymph node in the subcarinal space.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A measurement line (markup) is visible on a lymph node in the axial view, specifically measuring the shortest diameter.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the measurement as a markups JSON file to the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save' dialog or file browser shows 'subcarinal_measurement.mrk.json' being saved to '~/Documents/SlicerData/LIDC/'.

task_completion.description: The agent creates a JSON report with the required fields: station, lymph_node_identified, short_axis_mm, classification, and slice_position_mm.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output displays the content of 'lymph_node_report.json' containing all five required keys and values derived from the software interaction.

integrity.description: The agent used the 3D Slicer GUI tools to identify and measure the node rather than just writing a file via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with Slicer's 'Markups' or 'Ruler' module and the measurement line appearing on the CT image.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply copy the privileged information values into the report without performing the measurement.
integrity.visual_evidence: The measurement value in the final JSON matches the visual measurement value shown in the 3D Slicer UI overlay.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual LIDC-IDRI-0001 dataset loaded in the environment.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Slicer Data Probe or window title reflects the correct patient/case ID or image dimensions consistent with the LIDC dataset.

privileged_info_for_vlm: Station 7 refers to the subcarinal lymph nodes located inferior to the tracheal bifurcation. A short-axis diameter < 10mm is considered normal; 10-15mm is often considered indeterminate or borderline; > 15mm is typically classified as enlarged/pathological for this station. The measurement must be the short axis (perpendicular to the long axis) of the node.
